_comment: Bot-side ~/.claude/settings.json template. Deployed by entrypoint.sh to /home/coder/.claude/settings.json (and possibly /home/bot/.claude/settings.json depending on the bot uid setup). Hooks registered here fire for every CC session in the workspace.
_autoMemoryEnabled_comment: WS2: disables CC's native auto-memory system. The workspace has its own memory model at ~/project/memory/ — letting CC's native auto-memory run alongside creates two competing systems and instruction-level confusion. Per R.2 research outcome.
_autoUpdates_comment: The CLI version is deliberately set in the Dockerfile (CLAUDE_CODE_VERSION); a live auto-update would move a running deployment off the version it was tested on, so it stays off.
_model_comment: 2026-07-15: pin the bot model explicitly so a deploy is fully self-contained (merge_bot_settings does `existing * bootstrap`, bootstrap wins, re-merged every 5 min, so this is authoritative fleet-wide). 2026-11-05: Opus 5.5 by default, with the 2.1.311 CLI from the Dockerfile; IDE_WEB_MODEL overrides it per deployment, and a deployment back on the 2.1.150 CLI (TELEGRAM_TRANSPORT=plugin) must set a Sonnet-family model there.
_permissions_comment: Schedulers that need a live session or Anthropic's cloud: this self-hosted box has neither, and a job set with them never fires or dies with the session. Scheduling here is set_reminder and routines + the morning planner. A deny holds with --dangerously-skip-permissions too, on every turn and the bot (this file is merged into each home).
_hooks_comment: Memory writes go through the memory_write tool (workspace-api owns the one write path), so there is no post-write hook: the engine logs every write and the PreToolUse guard blocks raw file edits under memory/. Memory upkeep is silent by contract — no notification on any surface. WS5 C (Bundle 8): Stop hook fires verify-denials.sh — blocks the response if the model claims absence (skill/file/tool doesn't exist) without first running a lookup tool. 2026-06-04: second Stop hook verify-telegram-reply.sh — blocks the Telegram silent-response failure mode (turn triggered from Telegram bot tmux session BUT model didn't call any mcp__plugin_telegram_telegram__* tool). 2026-10-19: PostToolUse on Edit|MultiEdit|Write fires shared-file-note.mjs — when the edited file is shared by link, the model is told it is public, so a private detail does not land in it unnoticed. All hooks are fire-and-forget-safe — never break the turn over their own bugs. 2026-09-24: PreToolUse matcher `Skill` fires skill-fence.mjs — blocks the CLI's built-in `schedule` skill (Anthropic CLOUD routines, unreachable from a self-hosted box) and points the model at this product's actual routines path: memory_write into RESPONSIBILITIES + morning-planner in the same turn. Instruction alone lost to the built-in's own description, which advertises the word "routines".
